_source: Static UI keys for the mobile 'my PM jobs' screen (route pm-jobs, pototype/mobile-pm.jsx MPMJobs L7-49). KEYS ONLY - every value is the Thai phrase that IS the phrases-layer key (read with tp). SIX already exist in docs/extract/i18n-full.json phrases: 'วันนี้','ด่วน','ทั้งหมด','รอเริ่ม','เกินกำหนด','เริ่มงาน'. THREE are net-new and collected into agents/orch-b-recon/mobile-pm-jobs-i18n.apply.json for a Wei sacred round (eyebrow 'ช่าง PM', title 'งาน PM ของฉัน', statusInProgress 'กำลังทำ'); they already resolve in Thai today (tp returns the key for lang th) and light up en/zh/ar once applied. The prototype eyebrow 'ช่าง PM · สมพงษ์ ก.' drops the mock technician name (session-user data, no honest wire on this read); the mock WO number / PM-CM type / scheduled time / GPS distance / '(4)'/'(2)' filter counts are server/device data the wire does not carry - they are NOT i18n keys; the view em-dashes / omits them, never an invented value (§0 rule 3). Each value is byte-exact with the prototype.
_layers: all tp() = phrases (the Thai phrase is the key)
